_about: Public-domain historical plates used as distant backdrop behind the procedural city. Every work here is by an artist dead well over 70 years, so the works are public domain worldwide; the digitisations are hosted by Wikimedia Commons under PD-Art / PD-old. Files are NOT bundled — run `node tools/fetch-plates.mjs` to download them into art/. If the files are absent the survey simply renders without them.
_attribution: Attribution is shown in-app: the credits sheet (P) lists every plate, and the stratum dossier names the artist whenever a plate is on screen.
